2607.17551.title: Hierarchy-Aware and Anatomy-Guided Learning for Lung Ultrasound Video Classification
2607.17551.paper_summary: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is a bedside tool for assessing pulmonary edema in patients at risk due to heart failure or impaired kidney function. However, automated LUS analysis remains challenging because of speckle noise, imaging artifacts, and operator-dependent acquisition variability. In this work, we present a deep learning framework for multi-class LUS video classification that explores two components: hierarchy-aware training, and anatomy-guided learning. Starting from a strong baseline, we introduce hierarchical training strategies and then introduce pleural line mask supervision to guide model attention toward anatomically relevant regions. We study four clinically relevant classes--healthy, B-lines, consolidations, and mixed B-lines with consolidations--using an open-access dataset of 1,886 videos from 219 patients, evaluated with patient-level five-fold cross-validation. Results show that hierarchy-aware training improves pathological separation relative to flat classification, while mask-guided attention supervision achieves the highest mean macro-F1 of 65.7\% and produces more localized attention patterns. Transfer experiments on the external COVID-BLUeS dataset further show competitive and parameter-efficient adaptation while preserving pleural-focused attention behavior. These findings suggest that combining clinically structured objectives with anatomy-guided supervision is a practical approach to robust, interpretable LUS video analysis. Code and model implementations are available at https://github.com/Alya-Almsouti/LUS-video-classification.
2607.17551.paper_summary_zh: 肺部超聲波（LUS）是一種床邊工具，用於評估因心力衰竭或腎功能受損而有風險的患者的肺水腫。<lb/>然而，自動化的 LUS 分析仍然面臨挑戰，因為存在斑點噪聲、成像伪影和依賴操作員的獲取變異性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一個深度學習框架，用於多類別 LUS 視頻分類，探索兩個組件：層次感知訓練和解剖引導學習。<lb/>從一個強大的基準開始，我們引入了層次訓練策略，然後引入胸膜線掩模監督，以引導模型注意力朝向解剖學相關區域。<lb/>我們使用來自 219 名患者的 1,886 個視頻的開放訪問數據集，研究四個臨床相關類別——健康、B 線、實變和混合 B 線與實變——並通過患者級別的五折交叉驗證進行評估。<lb/>結果顯示，層次感知訓練相較於平面分類改善了病理分離，而掩模引導的注意力監督達到了 65.7\% 的最高平均宏 F1 分數，並產生了更具局部化的注意力模式。<lb/>在外部 COVID-BLUeS 數據集上的轉移實驗進一步顯示了競爭性和參數高效的適應，同時保持了以胸膜為重點的注意力行為。<lb/>這些發現表明，將臨床結構化目標與解剖引導監督相結合是一種實用的方法，用於穩健且可解釋的 LUS 視頻分析。<lb/>代碼和模型實現可在 https://github.com/Alya-Almsouti/LUS-video-classification 獲得。
